patch: R4 round 1 — PanicDial specialist (family 1: centroid readout + emulated bias)
directions: mu, class means, D, mhat, bias_centered computed from DIAGNOSTIC split ONLY (probe.npz hidden states, base model, answer position).
formula: Delta_c = scale*(2*D_c + bias_centered_c*m_hat) + gamma_c*m_hat, scale=0.10. gamma decomposed in EXPLANATION.md.

edits.label: calm
edits.value: coeff * D_calm from directions.npz (diagnostic class-mean hidden state minus global mean)
edits.mechanism: Delta += 0.2 * D_calm on row 19300 (' calm') of BOTH tied copies. Class-conditional direction from diagnostic final-hidden states only.

edits.label: calm
edits.mechanism: Delta += 0.306424 * m_hat (scale*bias_centered_calm; bias_centered=3.0642 = -||mu_calm||^2/||mu|| centred) on row 19300 of BOTH copies. Emulates the -||mu_c||^2 term of the nearest-centroid classifier as an effective per-class bias, since h.m_hat = 184.39 +/- 2.56 is near-constant.

edits.label: calm
edits.mechanism: Delta += gamma_calm * m_hat (gamma=0.00259161) on row 19300 of BOTH copies. Calibration: gamma = gamma_full + gamma_sim + gamma_resid, all measured on diagnostic only (see EXPLANATION.md for the decomposition). Compensates the input-side coupling (patched rows are also the INPUT embeddings of the label tokens in the instruction) plus the base rows' unequal mean logits.
